verdict.rationale: Formant is a SaaS robotics platform with AI features, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented control or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Choosing which data streams upload to the cloud is an adjacent control. The opt-in 'scoped research partnerships' mention does not say anything about model training. Neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
